subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook installation formally reject `HOOK.md` files larger than 1 MiB and non-regular-file metadata entries?
rationale: The patch fixes a concrete memory-exhaustion path but intentionally narrows the set of accepted hook package inputs, which requires owner intent rather than automated inference.

options.title: Accept the bounded regular-file contract
options.body: Land the 1 MiB regular-file requirement and treat oversized or symlinked metadata as invalid hook packages.

options.title: Revise the metadata contract
options.body: Choose another cap or preserve a documented symlink use case before merging, with corresponding tests and documentation.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded regular-file contract
recommendation.body: Land the 1 MiB regular-file requirement and treat oversized or symlinked metadata as invalid hook packages.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned reviewer and the strongest historical owner of the affected hook and fs-safe surfaces.
